label: alignment curated category
definition: Identifies the curated target category involved in the alignment.

label: alignment evidence
definition: Links the alignment to the documentary evidence on which the alignment judgement rests.

label: alignment relation
definition: Identifies the controlled analytical relation assigned to the alignment: close, narrower-than-curated, broader-than-curated or related. The value invalid-legacy-link marks alignments withdrawn to the quarantine graph.

label: alignment source
definition: Identifies the source statement or source-specified category being aligned.

label: has target category facet
definition: Associates a curated target category with a controlled analytical facet. The facet is descriptive metadata, not an ontological superclass.

label: applies in jurisdiction
definition: Identifies a jurisdiction in which the policy content is intended to have application or interpretive relevance.

label: constitutes target category
definition: Links a normative constitution rule to the source-specified category or status whose membership it establishes.

label: defines target category
definition: Links an explicit source definition to the source-defined policy target category whose extension criteria it states.

label: document reference year
definition: A reference, edition, or reporting year attached to a policy document. It is distinct from issue date, effective date, and explicit multi-year coverage or planning intervals.

label: evidence document
definition: Identifies the document in which the evidence location occurs.

label: evidence page
definition: Records a page or page-range locator supplied for a source-evidence record.

label: evidence source file name
definition: The file name recorded by the curated dataset for the source document used by an evidence record.

label: evidence text
definition: Records source text or an evidential excerpt supporting the assertion represented by an evidence record.

label: expresses content
definition: Links a policy document to abstract policy content expressed by it.

label: has document actor
definition: General relation from a policy document to an institutional actor standing in a document-level role.

label: has government post
definition: Inverse of post in organization.

label: has identity evidence
definition: Links an institutional actor to evidence supporting its identification or institutional classification in the curated corpus.

label: has institutional actor classification
definition: Links an organization to its institutional type in the controlled institutional actor type scheme; the classification is not treated as an ontological identity condition.

label: has jurisdiction evidence
definition: Links a jurisdiction individual to evidence supporting its identification or classification in the curated corpus.

label: has jurisdiction level
definition: Classifies a jurisdiction by a controlled level concept such as federal, national, subnational, or supranational.

label: has source evidence
definition: Links policy content or an assertion to a provenance record that identifies supporting documentary evidence.

label: has temporal interval
definition: Identifies the interval used by a temporal qualification assertion. The interval itself is represented using OWL-Time.

label: is constituted by
definition: Inverse of constitutes target category.

label: is defined by
definition: Inverse of defines target category.

label: is document actor for
definition: Inverse of has document actor.

label: is expressed in
definition: Links abstract policy content to a document that expresses it.

label: is operationalized by
definition: Inverse of operationalizes target category.

label: is specified by target-category statement
definition: Inverse of specifies target category.

label: issued by institutional actor
definition: Relates a policy document to the institutional actor explicitly identified as issuing it.

label: issues policy document
definition: Inverse of issued by institutional actor.

label: operationalizes target category
definition: Links an operationalization statement to the source-specified category whose membership criteria it operationalizes.

label: post in organization
definition: Relates a government post to the organization in which the source models that post as institutionally located.

label: published by institutional actor
definition: Relates a policy document to the institutional actor explicitly identified as publishing it.

label: publishes policy document
definition: Inverse of published by institutional actor.

label: qualifies policy document
definition: Temporal qualification of a policy document.

label: retrieved on
definition: The time at which the cited file was retrieved, recorded only where the file itself states it, such as a browser print header or a generation stamp.

label: source locator
definition: A page, section, paragraph, URL fragment, file offset, or comparable source-location locator.

label: source statement text
definition: Textual wording preserved from the source for a target-category statement. Its semantic function is given by the statement subclass, not inferred merely from the wording.

label: specifies target category
definition: General relation from a source target-category statement to the single source-specified category whose criteria or membership conditions it establishes.

label: temporally qualifies
definition: Identifies the single resource whose temporal qualification is asserted.

label: is version of
definition: Links a normative document version to the normative document whose text state it is.

label: evidence document version
definition: Identifies the version of a normative document in which the evidence location occurs.

label: version kind
definition: Classifies a normative document version as an original text or an official consolidation, using the document version kind scheme.

label: version identifier
definition: The citation, revision identifier or consolidation statement by which the publisher identifies the version, recorded as it appears in the source.

label: version in force from
definition: The date from which the publisher states that the text of this version applies. For an original text it is the date of entry into force or signature the source states; for a consolidation it is the in-force date of the latest incorporated amendment.

label: version current to
definition: The date up to which the publisher states that a consolidation is current.

label: superseding document
definition: Identifies the later document that, according to the source, replaces the earlier one.

label: superseded document
definition: Identifies the earlier document that, according to the source, is replaced.

label: supersession effective from
definition: The date from which the source states that the replacement takes effect.

label: publisher identifier
definition: An identifier the publisher assigns to the document or version and prints in it or in its official citation, such as an official citation, a law number, a Federal Register document number, an ISBN or a catalogue number. Recorded as it appears in the source.

label: publisher URI
definition: The persistent web address under which the publisher makes the document or version available, such as a European Legislation Identifier (ELI) or a law database address. Recorded only where the source prints it or the address was confirmed at the publisher.

label: administered by institutional actor
definition: Identifies the institutional actor that the source names as responsible for administering the document, such as the ministry printed in the header of a Korean statute.

label: prepared by institutional actor
definition: Identifies the institutional actor that the source names as having prepared the document for its issuer.

label: within jurisdiction
definition: Relates a jurisdiction to a wider jurisdiction whose law applies within it, such as a Member State and the European Union. The relation is transitive.

label: evidence source URI
definition: The web address of the page on which the evidence location occurs, for evidence taken from a web source rather than a file in the corpus. Such a record carries the retrieval time.
